github-poller.description: Watch configured GitHub repositories for actionable issues, pull requests, comments and reviews. Install mimir-cultivate and select MIMIR_PLUGINS=cultivate to seed <home>/skills/cultivate-github-poller/, then configure GITHUB_REPOS and MIMIR_GITHUB_SELF_LOGIN.
github-poller.body:
This poller ships in `mimir-cultivate`, not core. When selected with
`MIMIR_PLUGINS=cultivate`, provider defaults seed it under
`<home>/skills/cultivate-github-poller/`. The companion review command is
`/cultivate-review`, seeded at `<home>/skills/cultivate-review/`.

## Installation

1. Install `mimir-cultivate` and select `MIMIR_PLUGINS=cultivate`. At startup,
   provider defaults copy `plugins/cultivate/mimir_cultivate/defaults/skills/github-poller/`
   into `<home>/skills/cultivate-github-poller/`; configure it there rather
   than installing it from core's optional-skill catalog.

github-ci-watch.description: Watch GitHub Actions runs on the main branch of configured repositories; emit turns for new failures and remain silent while CI is green. Install mimir-cultivate and select MIMIR_PLUGINS=cultivate to seed <home>/skills/cultivate-github-ci-watch/, then set GITHUB_REPOS.
github-ci-watch.body:
A selected Cultivate poller skill. It is absent from core; installations
selecting `mimir-cultivate` with `MIMIR_PLUGINS=cultivate` seed it under
`<home>/skills/cultivate-github-ci-watch/`.

It watches the ``main`` branch of each ``GITHUB_REPOS`` entry, inspects
the last few GitHub Actions workflow runs, and emits one ``ci_failure``
event per newly-failed run (conclusion ``failure`` / ``timed_out`` /
``startup_failure``). Green builds produce **zero output** — the
"silence as filter" principle: this poller only speaks when CI breaks.

## Installation

1. Install `mimir-cultivate` and select `MIMIR_PLUGINS=cultivate`. On startup,
   the provider seeds `<home>/skills/cultivate-github-ci-watch/`. In a source
   checkout, the corresponding source is
   `plugins/cultivate/mimir_cultivate/defaults/skills/github-ci-watch/`.
